title: docs(qa): re-point the Studio checklist clauses QA run #29672 measured as stale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29679

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：测试清单里 6 个 Studio / i18n 测试项改为指向今天 main 上真实成立的行为：记录页改用声明了要点字段的「客户」对象；对象变体用 `activityMilestones` 替代已退役的 `titleFormat`；组织流程改用不带包的 PUT 造夹具；表单视图矩阵去掉已被拒收、或 Studio 已有控件的键；首次闭环分 en / zh-CN 两条腿各自判定；相对日期改读表格单元格的提示文字。只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` 下两个 JSON，不动产品代码。
- **为什么改**：QA 运行 #29672 把这些条款判红，但背后不是产品缺陷，而是条款过时。留着会让清单持续误报，真缺陷（zh-CN 首次发布进不了数据面，#29673）也会混在误报里看不清。
- **风险与回滚**：纯文档。每项 revision 加 1 并追加 history 行，旧运行记录仍按它当时的 revision 解读。zh-CN 腿今天会如实判失败，因为 #29673 还没修。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`studio-authoring.json` 的 `first-run-loop`（新增 zh-CN 腿与 knownGaps[3]）；同文件 `record-page-roundtrip`（对象从 showcase_contact 换成 showcase_account）；`i18n.json` 的 `studio-follows-app-locale` acceptance[1] 与 [2]。
- **两分钟验证**：在仓库根运行 `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，应输出 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 359 items`，退出码 0。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Checklist revision only, from QA run #29672 (read at `3482f3d8d2`). Every re-point was re-read on `main` at `339f63da30` (and the merge of `origin/main` at `0e4b0fa411` touches none of the cited sources). Each item gets a revision bump and one `history` row citing #29679 and the run.

| item | rev | what was stale | re-pointed to | evidence on main |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` | 13 → 14 | acceptance[0]: `showcase_contact` declares no `highlightFields`, so since #28907 its full create seeds no `record:highlights` | the whole item on `showcase_account` (fixtures, personas[1], steps[0]/[2]/[6], acceptance[0] and [3], automated.ref) | `account.object.ts` declares `highlightFields: ['status', 'industry', 'annual_revenue']`; `deriveHighlightFields` (plugin-detail `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`) draws declared fields only; no showcase page names the object; the everyone baseline `showcase_member_default` reads it |
| `studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save` | 3 → 4 | variants[0]: `titleFormat` is refused at save and publish since 3557366c02 | `activityMilestones` | graded live in `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`; no Studio surface writes it; the run's matrix read its runtime row hold. `nameField` (the prescription) is not used: Studio has a control for it (`ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx`) |
| `studio-authoring.org-scope-flows` | 2 → 3 | fixtures.requires[1], steps[1]: the clone door lands in `BASE.custom` since #28149 | `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_org_raw` with no `?package=` and no `?mode=` | ADR-0146 D11 closes a package-less write only onto a shipped item (`packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`); the run read this PUT answer 200 |
| `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix` | 4 → 5 | the view.form row: `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` answer 422; Studio now offers Layout, Columns, Default Tab, Tab Position | `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` listed as refused at parse; `layout`, `defaultTab`, `tabPosition` out of the matrix per step 4; knownGaps[0] says why | `retiredKey` tombstones in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`; `ViewVariantInspector.tsx` hands the form variant's spec schema to `SchemaForm`; the layout canvas fail was #29676, which #29759 closed |
| `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` | 10 → 11 | names no locale; only zh-CN fails | an en leg and a zh-CN leg, each on its own boot, every clause scored per leg (new negative[2]); knownGaps[3] records the zh-CN failure | #29673 is open; `isInjectedColumnDefinition` is still byte-for-byte and the `registerObject` failure is still a `console.warn` in `protocol.ts` |
| `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale` | 7 → 8 | acceptance[2] (the card's "[3]" is the run's one-based number): a grid paints the absolute date, relative only as the tooltip; and, from the addendum, acceptance[1] / negative[0] counted an authored label as a mixed-language fail | acceptance[2] reads the date cell's `title` (oracle `dom`), both directions; acceptance[1] and negative[0] carry the authored-override exception | `DateCellRenderer` with `inGridColumn` (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`); ADR-0029 D9.2a and `translateObject`, pinned by `i18n-resolver.test.ts` and `meta-object-i18n-explicit-override.test.ts` |

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviations from the card's table, each measured.** The card names the relative-date clause `acceptance[3]`; it is `acceptance[2]` zero-based (the run numbered from one). In the same items I also corrected four stale readings from the same run: org-scope-flows `steps[0]` (the empty state now has no Open in Setup link), first-run-loop `steps[1]` (since #29734 a Chinese name derives a pinyin package id, so "derives no package id" no longer held), the matrix's object `titleFormat` cell (now a refusal), and the matrix's `buttons` cell (already measured rendering by revision 3's knownGaps).
- **Not re-driven live at this base.** Every re-point is read from source, seed data and the run's own readings. record-page acceptance[1] to [3] passed on `showcase_contact` in the run and are not yet driven on `showcase_account`.
- **Fixture gaps the card names that this PR does not add.** The two launch entries (`OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` for flow-status-matches-runtime, `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false` for custom-page-source-tiers) live in `.claude/launch.json`, not in the checklist's own fixture declarations, which already name both boots. picklist-bound-select's fixture needs a picklist in the showcase's `objectstack.config.ts`, a seed-data change. Both are left to the seat.
- **Notes, not filed.** (1) Studio's landing card `engine.studio.org.description` (en and zh, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/`) still says the scope holds "a clone of a packaged flow", which #28149 made untrue; read from source only. (2) `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale` knownGaps[0] says 414 untranslated labels; `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` reads 320. (3) `packages/spec/liveness/object.json` grades `titleFormat` live while the save gate refuses it. (4) The form-view inspector's `SchemaForm` may offer controls for more `view.form` keys than the four the run named; the next run's step 4 census decides. (5) `defaultTab` / `tabPosition`'s partial runtime effect leaves this matrix with them, and no other item claims it.

## Verification

```text
node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs          # OK, exit 0
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack
```
